headline: Jags unlikely to play 3 international games in 2027 during EverBank renovations
summary: Jaguars team president Mark Lamping said the team is unlikely to play three international home games in 2027 while renovations to EverBank Stadium continue.

headline: Sources: Eagles' Jalen Hurts, out indefinitely with blood clot, not planned for IR
summary: The Eagles are not planning to put Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, sources told ESPN, even as he remains sidelined indefinitely with a superficial blood clot.
